rationale: A1 action production is an ordinary player action; a missing applicability profile is an implementation defect solved by a class profile, not a game outcome (AGENTS.md AI §10.1).

The loaded A1 profile is class-neutral (validNeutralActionProductionProfile); the per-place list in target-runtime-profiles-approved.json (32 generated scopes at template version 1, one canonical G5) cannot match capacity-v2 generated sites, whose generated_template_ref.authoring_version is 2 (live PostgreSQL dump, 2026-09-29), so A1 is refused on every generated G5.
The rule adds no authority: the item, access, mass and tool checks of the A1 owner still apply at every place; only the per-place admission list is replaced.
